scope: Federato readability and Intact mobile accessibility
browser_checks: The Federato needs-review queue contains the single unresolved submission
The portfolio shows a bundled United States outline, state labels, exposure cells, and submissions when external map tiles are blocked
The Expo address, about, and quote screens have no horizontal overflow at 390 by 844
An empty address submission scrolls to and focuses the address field and exposes an assertive associated error
Expo source links and their explanatory text appear as separate accessibility nodes
notes: The API and pricing engine were unchanged
The portfolio fallback was tested by blocking tiles.openfreemap.org
Physical phone capabilities were not reverified
